name: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Ltd.
about: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides financial products and services in the renewable energy and energy efficiency sectors in India. The company promotes, develops, and extends financial assistance for setting up projects relating to new and renewable sources of energy and energy efficiency/conservation; and environmental technologies for sustainable development. It also generates solar, wind, hydro, biomass, biofuels, and waste to energy power. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India.

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~15% a year growth, below the ~25% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 19 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 28), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 19 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 30 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 32% a year while PE moved 20 → 19.
